verdict.rationale: Kimi's own help center lists '定时任务' (scheduled tasks) alongside search, memory and skills as a general feature, so a first-party scheduling capability exists. The only evidence is a single category label, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of recurring versus one-off scheduling, evidence that tasks run autonomously and deliver results back to the user, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
